request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:FIGHTER

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: a cheerful sweet shop of many different sweets, bright, glossy and silly. Its fixed colours: glossy milk and dark chocolate brown; golden caramel and toffee; pale biscuit wafer; matte marshmallow white and cream; clear jewel-coloured gummy jelly and hard candy in apple green, lemon yellow and amber orange; white peppermint with mint green stripes; a little liquorice black; cotton-candy pink frosting, colour #ffb8d8, only as a small trim; one hard pure white highlight on every glossy surface.
layers.negative: crimson, red, magenta, hot pink, neon pink, purple, violet, all-pink body, pink blob, metal armour, steel, iron, sword, fur, bone, skull, scary, horror, realistic, banana guard, giant humanoid guardian robot with a gumball head, pink-haired princess, lab coat with a crown, peppermint butler, lemon-headed figure, cartoon show character

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Subject: a chunky cute living peppermint sweet soldier with no separate head and no neck: the whole figure is one big fat round hard-candy disc seen from the front, glossy white with six bold mint green stripes, colour #3fbf8a, swirling out from its centre like a pinwheel, with one hard white highlight, and two short twisted fan-shaped ends of clear white wrapper sticking out at its left and right; the face is in the middle of the disc itself, two big round black dot eyes and a small happy smile; two tiny stubby white arms and two tiny round dark chocolate brown feet directly under the disc; it holds one oversized candy-cane spear with mint green and white stripes and a hooked top upright in one hand, and a small round dark chocolate shield on its other arm; no helmet, no hair and no clothes; simple shapes and very few details.
The peppermint disc is drawn very large: about 46 pixels across, so the figure fills most of the image like the other soldiers of the game.
